findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "pump" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pump_history, copy_backtest, dlmm_positions · Private data: pump_pulse, pump_launches, pump_token, pump_wallet, pump_dev, smart_money, copy_backtest, dlmm_pool, dlmm_positions, dlmm_whales · Public sink: pump_history, pump_token.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pump_history, copy_backtest, dlmm_positions · Private data: pump_pulse, pump_launches, pump_token, pump_wallet, pump_dev, smart_money, copy_backtest, dlmm_pool, dlmm_positions, dlmm_whales · Public sink: pump_history, pump_token

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
